summary.text: Wyatt Gable is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 14 in Onslow County who assumed office on January 1, 2025, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists a 2021 high school diploma from White Oak High School and says that as of 2024 he was attending East Carolina University.

paragraphs.text: Gable succeeded Republican George Cleveland in House District 14, according to Ballotpedia.
As of 2024 he was affiliated with East Carolina University's chapter of Turning Points USA, Ballotpedia reports.

Gable serves on the House Appropriations, Higher Education, Homeland Security and Military and Veterans Affairs, and Housing and Development committees, the Appropriations Subcommittee on Education, the House Select Committee on Government Efficiency and the Joint Legislative Education Oversight Committee.
